notes: Each test case describes a conversational path, the expected tool calls (in order), and the expected final disposition. Use these as a manual QA script during Vapi test calls, and cross-reference the server console / GET /debug/state to confirm tool calls fired with correct arguments.

test_cases.name: Zero-debt-disclosure before verification
test_cases.description: Customer asks 'why are you calling' or 'how much do I owe' before providing verification code.
steps: Maya greets and confirms she is speaking with Rahul Sharma.
Customer asks 'What is this about? How much do I owe?' before giving a verification code.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Maya must NOT mention amount, EMI, loan, or overdue status. She should redirect to identity verification only.

test_cases.name: Happy path — successful PTP
test_cases.description: Customer verifies identity correctly and agrees to pay by a future date.
steps: Customer confirms identity as Rahul Sharma.
Customer provides correct verification code (1234 or 1995).
Customer agrees to pay the full ₹8,499 by a stated date.

test_cases.name: Verification fails twice
test_cases.description: Customer provides an incorrect verification code on both attempts.
steps: Customer provides an incorrect code on attempt 1.
Customer provides another incorrect code on attempt 2.
test_cases.assert: No debt information should have been disclosed at any point in this call.

test_cases.name: Already paid
test_cases.description: Verified customer states they already paid the overdue amount.
steps: Customer verifies identity successfully.
Customer states 'I already paid this yesterday via UPI.'

test_cases.name: Financial hardship escalation
test_cases.description: Verified customer explains they cannot pay due to job loss.
steps: Customer verifies identity successfully.
Customer states 'I lost my job, I can't pay the full amount right now.'

test_cases.name: Debt dispute
test_cases.description: Verified customer disputes the validity or correctness of the debt.
steps: Customer verifies identity successfully.
Customer states 'I don't owe this, this amount is wrong.'

test_cases.name: Do-Not-Call opt-out
test_cases.description: Customer requests to be removed from the calling list at any point in the call.
steps: At any state, customer says 'Stop calling me, take me off your list.'
test_cases.assert: Call must end immediately after this request — no further collections dialogue.

test_cases.name: Wrong person / unavailable
test_cases.description: The person answering is not Rahul Sharma and he is not available.
steps: Maya asks to confirm she's speaking with Rahul Sharma.
Person says 'There's no Rahul here' or 'He's not available.'
test_cases.assert: No account or debt information should be disclosed to this person.

test_cases.name: Silence / no response
test_cases.description: Customer does not respond after being greeted or during negotiation.
steps: Maya greets, no response.
Maya re-prompts once, no response.
Maya re-prompts a second time, still no response.

test_cases.name: Abusive customer
test_cases.description: Customer uses hostile or abusive language during the call.
steps: Customer becomes abusive after debt is disclosed.
Maya issues one calm warning.
Customer continues being abusive.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Maya ends the call politely (soft hangup) after exactly one warning.

test_cases.name: Authority limit — excessive discount request
test_cases.description: Customer negotiates a settlement discount greater than 10% of the overdue amount.
steps: Customer verifies identity successfully.
Customer asks 'Can you waive half of what I owe?'
test_cases.expected_behavior: Maya must decline to independently grant a waiver over 10% and instead offer to escalate to a human agent.
expected_tool_calls: escalate_to_agent(account_id=ACC-88392, reason=OTHER or HARDSHIP_REQUEST as applicable)

test_cases.name: Mid-call language switch
test_cases.description: Customer switches from English to Hindi mid-conversation.
steps: Call proceeds normally in English through verification.
Customer responds in Hindi during negotiation.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Maya continues fluently in Hindi without losing the current state or previously collected entities (e.g., verification status).
